namespace Geometry.Core;

using System.Threading.Tasks;

public interface IShape : IMeasurable, INamed
{
    double Area();
    double Perimeter() => 0;
    string Name { get; }
    static IShape Empty => null!;
    event EventHandler<ShapeEventArgs> Changed;
}

internal interface IMeasurable { }

public interface INamed { string Name { get; } }

public interface IRepository<T> where T : class, IShape, new()
{
    Task<T?> FindAsync(int id, CancellationToken ct = default);
    IAsyncEnumerable<T> All();
}

public delegate void ShapeHandler(IShape shape, ShapeEventArgs args);
public delegate TResult Mapper<TIn, TResult>(TIn input);
public delegate Owner OwnerFactory();
public delegate Owner? MaybeOwner(int id);
